reference: Biribiara nni adaka no mu, gye aboɔ apono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ no.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Adɛn na mo akoma tutuo, na adɛn nti na adwene sɔresɔre mo akoma mu?

reference: Yosia ahennie ho asɛm nkaeɛ ne dwuma a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa no, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
hypothesis: Yosia ahenni yɛ ho asɛm nkae ne dwuma a odii nyinaa no, wɔtwerɛgow Yuda ahemfo aba kɔsɛm nhoma ne mo.

reference: Na Saulo wui ne fom a ɔfom AWURADE no, ne AWURADE asɛm a wanni soɔ no, ne sɛ nso ɔkɔbisaa samanfrɛni hɔ adeɛ hwehwɛɛ n’akyiri kwan.

reference: Yei ne deɛ Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, ka kyerɛɛ me: “Gye saa kuruwa yi a mʼabufuhyeɛ nsã ahyɛ no ma yi, na ma amanaman a mɛsoma wo wɔn nkyɛn no nyinaa nnom.

reference: Yesu buaa no sɛ, “Wɔatwerɛ sɛ: ‘Ɛnyɛ aduane nko ara na ɛho hia onipa wɔ nʼasetena mu.
hypothesis: Yesu boa no sɛ, wɔatwerɛw sɛ, ɛnyɛ aduaneko a na ɛho hia onipa wo nʼasetena mu.

reference: Na mpo, ɔyɛ omumuyɛfoɔ sene Amorifoɔ a wɔbɛtenaa asase yi so ansa na Israel reba no.
hypothesis: Na mpo ɔyɛ amumuyefo se ne amorifo a wɔbɛtena asase yi so ansa na Israel Yeban no.

reference: Na wɔrebɛn akuraa a wɔrekɔ aseɛ no, ɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɔrekɔ n’anim.

reference: Ɔno na monhunuu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no die, na mo ho siane mo anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wɔ mu mu, sɛ monya mo gyidie akatua a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no.

reference: Na wɔtu firii Alus kɔkyeree nsraban Refidim; na ɛhɔ na ɔman no annya nsuo annom.

reference: Yɛhunuu ne nsoromma wɔ apueeɛ nohoa enti na yɛaba sɛ yɛrebɛsom no.
hypothesis: Yehu no ne nsoromma wɔ apoe no ho a nti ne abasa yɛɛ bɛsom no.

reference: Na Amon nkoa pam ne tiri so, na wɔkumm ɔhene no wɔ ne fie.
hypothesis: Na Amon, koapam ne tiriso; na wokum ɔhene no, wɔn fie.

reference: Menam wɔn a mesomaa wɔn wɔ mo nkyɛn no bi so mebɛsisii mo anaa?
hypothesis: Menam wɔn a mesomaa wɔn wɔ mo nkyɛn no bi so me besesie mu anaa.

reference: Na asraafoɔ nso bisaa no sɛ: Yɛn nso yɛnyɛ dɛn?
hypothesis: Na asraafo no nso bisaa no sɛ, yɛn nso yɛannya dɛn?

reference: Ɛberɛ biara na mema asafo ahodoɔ no ho nsɛm yɛ me asɛnhia.
hypothesis: Ɛbɛebuaa na me ma asafo aho dɔɔ no ho nsɛm yɛ me asenhiara.

hypothesis: Na ne wura no bo fui, na ɔde no maa ahohinhiafo sɛ eko si sɛ obetua, na ɔde ɔde no nyinaa.

reference: Nnwanhwɛfoɔ a wɔsɛe me nnwankuo bɔ wɔn pete no nnue!

reference: Na sɛ mehoahoa me ho boro so kakra wɔ tumi a Awurade de ama yɛn mo nkɔsoɔ, na ɛnyɛ mo dwirie nti no ho mpo a, m’ani renwu, na manyɛ sɛ deɛ mede nwoma mebɛyi mo hu.
hypothesis: Na sa mehoahoa a mehɔboroo so kakra wɔ tumi a Awurade de ama yɛn, mo nkɔ so ɔ, na ɛnyɛ mo dwiriw enti no ho mpo a mʼani nnwu, na manyɛ sɛ de a mede nhoma me beyi mu ho.

hypothesis: Na hwee, wobibaa hɔ bɛsɛe no sɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ade pa bɛn na menyɛ na manyadaa nkwa?

hypothesis: Na Dawid kɔɔ dɔe na ɔkaa sɛ, hwee na ɔbɛma me Betlehem asubura a ɛwɔ kuropono no ano mu nsuoa anom.

hypothesis: na woguu nhwiren a wɔahyehyɛ etia ho nyinaa Ahyiae.

hypothesis: Yesu boa no sɛ, wɔakyerɛw sɛ, som Awurade wo nyankopɔn, na ɔno nko anasom.

reference: Na Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa baa ɔhene no nkyɛn Hebron, na Dawid ne wɔn pam AWURADE anim wɔ Hebron, na wɔsraa Dawid ngo sii no Israel so hene, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Samuel so kaeɛ no teɛ.

reference: Na ɔne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa, mpataa dodoɔ a wɔyiiɛ no nti, wɔn ho dwirii wɔn; na sɛ nso ɛyɛɛ Yakobo ne Yohane, Sebedeo mma a wɔyɛ Simon mfɛfoɔ ara ne no.

reference: Ɔdii ɔhene, bunkam faa ahemfo nyinaa so, firi Asubɔnten Eufrate ano de kɔsi Filistifoɔ asase ne Misraim hyeɛ so.

reference: Ɛnna Petro ka kyerɛɛ Yesu sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛ sɛ yɛtena ha; sɛ wopɛ a, mɛbɔ asese mmiɛnsa, wo deɛ baako, Mose deɛ baako, na Elia deɛ baako.
hypothesis: “ ‘Ɛyɛ sɛ ɛtena ha, sɛ wo pa a, mɛbɔ ase sɛ me yensa: Wode yɛ baako, Mose de yɛ baako, na Elia de yɛ baako.

reference: Na wɔyiyii wɔn ho nnoɔma, na wɔfaa ne ti ne n’akodeɛ soma maa wɔde kyinii Filistifoɔ asase so, sɛ wɔnkɔpae nkyerɛ wɔn ahoni ne ɔman no.
hypothesis: Na woyii wɔn ho nneɛma, na wɔfaa ne ti ɛne nʼakodii soma ma wɔde ne Filistifo nsase so, sɛ wɔnkɔ pae nkyerɛ wɔn ahonnee ne ɔmae no.

reference: Na AWURADE bo fuu Israel, na ɔmaa wɔkyinkyinii ɛserɛ so mfirinhyia aduanan kɔsii sɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔyɛɛ AWURADE anim bɔne no nyinaa wiee sa.
hypothesis: Na Awurade bo fuw Israel, na wɔmaa wɔkyinkyinii ɛsra so mfirihyia aduanan a ɛkosi sɛ awo ntoatoaso a wɔyɛɛ Awurade anim bɔne no wiee sa.

reference: Na wɔtu firii Dibon-gad kɔkyeree nsraban Almon-diblataim.

reference: Yeinom ne Salomo adwuma so ahwɛfoɔ mu mpanin: Ahanum aduonum a wɔdi nkurɔfoɔ a wɔkura adwuma no mu no soɔ.
hypothesis: Yennom ne Salomo adwuma so ahwɛfo mu mpanyin; ahannom aduonum a wodii nkɔɔfo a wokura adwuma no mu no so.

reference: Afei, wɔbɛhwɛ mmeamu nnua, mpunan, nsisisoɔ ne ɛho nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa.
hypothesis: Afei wɔbɛhwɛ mmeamuon nua, mpo nne, nsususow ne ɛho nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa.

reference: Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Yei ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni soɔ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no.
hypothesis: Na Mose hyɛ Israelfo no sɛ, yɛe ne asase a mo mfa nto ntobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni so a Awurade ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuw nkurow ne fa no.
